name: zotero-modified
description: Unofficial Zotero 10 workflow tools: safe local curation, ethereal style metadata supported, and customized citation format.

interface.shortDescription: Zotero curation, status/rating conventions, and CSL tools
interface.longDescription: An unofficial extension of the upstream OpenAI Zotero workflow, compatible with Ethereal Style metadata. It adds an up-front local-API authorization gate, one-confirmation multi-item curation, structured metadata updates, native colored tags, slash-prefixed statuses, Extra ratings, deduplication, and local CSL installation. Dry-run previews and snapshots are produced only when requested.
defaultPrompt: create and curate a collection with a preview before every write
write statuses, ratings, roles, and controlled topical metadata following Ethereal Style conventions
write and install a CSL template for Zotero Word integration
